youtube.title: 97% of Day Traders Lose Money. Here's the Proof #Shorts
youtube.description:
97% of day traders who kept going for 300 days lost money. Here's the data behind that number, and why the 2026 change to the $25,000 day trading rule doesn't change the math.

• Brazil, people who started day trading futures in 2013–2015 and persisted 300+ days: 97% lost money; only 0.4% earned more than a bank teller (Chague, De-Losso & Giovannetti, FGV)
• Taiwan, 1992–2006: less than 1% of day traders were predictably profitable after fees (Barber, Lee, Liu & Odean, 2014)
• 2026: the SEC approved FINRA rule changes that remove the $25,000 pattern day trader minimum

Full guide on the channel: "Why 97% of Day Traders Lose Money (The Data)".
